configurePresets.name: macos-clang
configurePresets.description: Canonical macOS toolchain: Homebrew LLVM clang + libc++. Pins the compiler because A-tier integration goldens are a fingerprint of a chaotic long run and diverge ~99% between clang and gcc codegen; a consistent compiler keeps locally-generated macos/ goldens reproducible across worktrees. Requires a Homebrew shell env (HOMEBREW_PREFIX set, e.g. via `eval "$(brew shellenv)"`) and `brew install llvm`.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: Release build into build/ on the canonical clang toolchain.

configurePresets.name: macos-tests
configurePresets.description: Release + tests into build-tests/ on the canonical clang toolchain, so A-tier goldens stay compiler-consistent.

configurePresets.name: headless
configurePresets.description: Release build into build-headless/ with COAST_WITH_GUI=OFF: no SDL2, no OpenGL, no ImGui, no embedded console. Needs only TBB and HDF5, so it configures on a machine with no graphics stack at all. Pins no compiler, unlike the macos presets: their pin exists for the clang-repl console (Homebrew libLLVM is libc++-built), which a headless build does not have. Consequence on macOS: this selects AppleClang, which is untested here, and its A-tier goldens are not comparable with the macos/ ones. Add -DCOAST_GPU_BACKEND=none for the leanest possible build.

configurePresets.name: headless-tests
configurePresets.description: Release + tests into build-headless-tests/ with COAST_WITH_GUI=OFF. The GUI-layer suites (unit.gui_plot, unit.console, the b-tier simc cases) are not built; everything else runs.
